summary_en: Tender offer to delist Dentsū Sōken Inc. (TSE Prime, 4812) at ¥2,880/share. Offeror: LLC VIC (ITOCHU 80%, IFP subsidiary 20%). Minimum acceptance: 9.34M shares. Tender period: 20 business days (Nov 2026 target, subject to regulatory clearance). Japan, China, EU antitrust approvals required; filings expected Oct 2026, clearance expected by early Nov 2026. Target board recommends participation.
title_en: Notice regarding scheduled commencement of public tender offer for shares of Dentsū Sōken Inc. (securities code: 4812)
translation_en_brief: ITOCHU Corporation and LLC VIC (a joint venture 80% owned by ITOCHU and 20% by subsidiary IFP) announced plans to launch a public tender offer to acquire all ordinary shares of Dentsū Sōken Inc. (TSE Prime, code 4812) and take the company private. The tender price is ¥2,880 per share, with a minimum acceptance threshold of 9,340,400 shares and no upper limit. The tender period is to be 20 business days, commencing around early November 2026, contingent upon satisfaction (or waiver by the offeror) of conditions precedent including competition-law clearances from Japan, China, and the EU. The acquirers expect to file antitrust notifications with each jurisdiction by early October 2026 and receive clearance by early November 2026; actual timing depends on regulatory procedures and cannot be precisely forecast. The target's board of directors recommends participation in the tender. The disclosure notes that the offeror is publishing this announcement before the formal tender offer registration to enable China antitrust filing procedures, which require public disclosure of the proposed transaction.
